evidence.requirements: Met: list with heading, exact-name links, family and L3 (catalog.js:62-74); Search over name and alternative names and the Family select with '<n> cartridges' (catalog.js:26-48, detail.js:18-33); identity block with capacity and source link (detail.js:42-64); grouped Symbol/Value/Unit tables with tolerances beside the value (format.js:145-161); Print button, 'All cartridges' link, hash address that survives a reload (router.js, app.js); inline SVG at 1 unit = 1 mm with aria-label '<name> drawing', section hatched below the axis, dash-dot centre line, title block (drawing.js:232-294); notes for missing values (geometry.js); @page A4 print rules. Partly met or unmet: (1) the shoulder angle α has no dimension: no arc, arrowheads or extension lines, only a floating text label (drawing.js:162-169; on detail-9_3_x_74_r.jpg it sits beside 'L3 74.7' at the top). (2) Several labels are placed far from their dimension lines, so the reader cannot tell which value belongs to which line: L3 and L6 labels stacked above the L6 line on detail-9_mm_luger.jpg and detail-22_long_rifle.jpg; 'R 1.09 -0.18' far to the left. (3) 'Lengths and diameters are in mm', but S, u, b, h, s and G show no unit (format.js:26-34, detail-308_win.jpg: u 305, S 55.46). (4) The print drawing is not at full width: the cartridge spans about half the page width in print-308_win.jpg (height capped at 125 mm, styles.css:442-446). (5) The scale is given only as a 10 mm bar; no scale ratio.
evidence.correctness: The geometry follows the rules closely. Chamfer inset min(f·tanβ, R1/4) (geometry.js:145); groove floor and ramp (165-185); belt ramp at δ to R3/2, then to E, then a step to P1/2 (169-175); rimfire half-round of radius min(R/2, (R1-P1)/2) (197); shoulder through the published points with r1 min and r2 tangent fillets (386-404); s, k and m per shape and category (224-238); tangent-ogive ρ formula and quarter ellipse (245-270); heeled exposed radius H2/2 and seated radius H2/2 - tb (289-290); tn, tb and w; primer pockets (15-23). Proportions match the references: length-to-rim ratio about 6.0 for the 308 against 5.9 in reference/308_win.png, about 3.65 for the 22 LR against 3.6, and the belt is visible on detail-300_win_mag.jpg. Deviations: on belted cases w takes E + tb rather than the belt-ramp-end term, and the test asserts this (geometry.js:336-337, geometry.test.js:165-170). Inner walls are offset radially, not along the normal. The α value is shown but not dimensioned. Length units are missing on S, u, b, h, s and G. The print fits one A4 page (print-308_win.jpg) but the drawing is not at full width.
evidence.security: All data goes through escapeHtml before innerHTML (format.js:72-79; used in detail.js, catalog.js, drawing.js:226-249). No eval, no fetch, no external assets (index.html, which loads only local scripts); the e2e test asserts there are no non-file requests (app.e2e.test.js:124-131). The capacity URL is escaped and opened only by a user click.
evidence.code_quality: Small pure modules (format, catalog, router, geometry, layout, drawing, detail) with a thin DOM glue file (app.js, 69 lines). Naming is clear and documented constants are used. Missing values are handled with notes instead of exceptions. The UMD-style dual export is repeated in every file, a little boilerplate. buildModel returns two differently shaped objects for early exits (geometry.js:365, 421).
evidence.tests: Unit tests cover each geometry rule with numbers taken from the records: chamfer, rimfire half-round, groove, belt, shoulder angle, fillets, bullet s, k and m, ogive tangency, heeled bullet, walls, w, pockets, missing values (geometry.test.js). Label tests check for overlaps, line contacts and viewBox containment on all 25 records (labels.test.js). Formatting, tolerances and every value appearing once are tested (format.test.js); so are search, filter and routes (catalog.test.js), golden data (data.test.js), and e2e checks for file:// loading, reload, no network, phone overflow, one A4 page for all 25 records and dark mode. Gaps: the e2e suite silently skips without a browser; nothing tests the association between a label and its line or the α dimension; some tests lock in the deviations (unitOf('S') === '', w on belted cases).
evidence.ux_design: The tables are dense and well structured with tabular monospace numbers (detail-308_win.jpg). The drawing is legible, but the label text is oversized next to the small cartridge. The title block is as large as the drawing or larger (detail-9_mm_luger.jpg, detail-22_long_rifle.jpg). Diameter labels R1, E1 and P1 stack below the head away from their lines. α floats between axial dimensions (detail-9_3_x_74_r.jpg, detail-300_win_mag.jpg). Empty 'Junction cone' tables with only a header row are shown for pistols (detail-44_rem_mag.jpg). The print layout packs the tables into three columns and stays on one page (print-308_win.jpg). There is no screenshot of dark mode; the CSS has a palette for it.
evidence.accessibility: The SVG has role=img and an aria-label (drawing.js:232). The tables use th scope=col and scope=row (detail.js:69-75). The controls have visible labels; the count is announced with aria-live (detail.js:24-30). A focus-visible outline is set (styles.css:69-72), the button is native, html lang=en. Muted text contrast is about 5.5:1. The drawing's text alternative is only its name; the tables give the data. No skip link.
evidence.simplicity: No runtime dependencies. One dev dependency (playwright-core 1.64.1). About 1,300 lines of app code. The label-placement search (layout.js) is justified by the no-overlap rule. A fit-for-purpose size.
evidence.maintainability: The README gives run and test commands and the folder layout. package-lock.json is present and the dev dependency is pinned exactly; engines is node>=22 only and there is no .nvmrc. Regression tests are broad. No CI configuration. No release or changelog process beyond version 1.0.0. The README says openspec/ holds 'the specification and the design, tasks and decisions', but the directory has only specs/.gitkeep, so there are no specs or ADRs in the repository.
evidence.visual_design: A calm neutral palette with one accent, a consistent type scale, uppercase section headings and monospace figures look technical and consistent across pages (list.jpg, detail-*.jpg). The drawing panel looks unbalanced: big sans-serif labels, a heavy title-block frame and a lot of empty white space around a small cartridge (detail-22_long_rifle.jpg, detail-9_mm_luger.jpg).
evidence.layout: The hierarchy is right: name, identity, drawing, then tables in two columns. The list is clean with right-aligned L3 values (list.jpg). Inside the drawing, space is used poorly: vertical gaps between axial levels on straight cases (no L1 or L2 levels, yet L3 and L6 sit at levels 3 and 4), labels far from their dimensions, and a title block larger than the figure. No clipping or overlap is visible in the screenshots.
evidence.usability: Finding a cartridge and opening it is a two-step task. Search filters while typing and keeps focus (e2e test). The count is visible. The empty state reads 'No cartridge matches the search.' Bookmarkable hash routes, a 'Cartridge not found' page with a link back, a clear Print button and 'All cartridges' link. Matching a drawing label to its line takes effort.
evidence.reception: Accurate data presentation and a professional, quiet look would earn trust from reloaders and gunsmiths. Engineers would notice that α is not dimensioned, that some lengths lack units (u 305, S 55.46) and that the label placement is looser than on OpenBallistics. Usable, but it would not yet replace the reference.

unmet_requirements: The shoulder angle α has no dimension: no arc, arrowheads or extension lines, only a floating text label (drawing.js:162-169)
Several dimension labels are far from their lines and ambiguous (L3 and L6 stacked above the L6 line on short cases, α beside L3, R far to the left)
Lengths S, u, b, h, s and G are shown without the mm unit (format.js:26-34)
The printed drawing is not at full width; the cartridge spans about half the A4 width (print-308_win.jpg)
Belted solid-head depth w uses E + tb rather than the belt-ramp-end term (geometry.js:336-337)
The title block shows the scale only as a 10 mm bar, with no ratio
strengths: The geometry engine applies nearly every drawing rule exactly (chamfer, groove, belt, rimfire half-round, fillets, ogive, heeled bullet, walls, pockets), and the proportions match the OpenBallistics references
Clean, dependency-free, file://-safe code with escaped output and no network requests
Strong test suite: per-rule geometry tests, label overlap checks on all 25 records, and e2e checks for reload, phone width and one A4 page per record
issues: Dimensioning is weak: α is not dimensioned, and several labels sit far from their lines, so values are ambiguous to read
Unit errors in the tables: length fields S, u, b, h, s and G show no mm
Drawing composition and print: oversized labels and title block next to a small cartridge, the print drawing at only half width, and no CI or the spec and ADR docs the README promises
review.verdict: A careful, well-tested implementation whose geometry follows the brief's rules and the reference proportions, with correct data and a clean, technical presentation. The dimensioning (no α dimension, labels detached from their lines), the missing length units and the half-width print drawing need fixing before it is published to an engineering audience.
